title: Character Curio character
description: A JSON schema for a Character Curio player character sheet.

id.description: Stable identifier joining this set to its sheet template layout. Assigned once and never regenerated.

name.description: The name of the trait set.

description.description: A description of the trait set.

noun.description: The singular noun used to describe a trait in this set.

plural.description: The plural noun used to describe multiple traits in this set.

traits.description: The traits in the trait set.

counterLabel.description: Label for the secondary counter column header, e.g. 'XP'.

pool.description: Staging behaviour: adding a trait stages its whole array of available dice.

spendable.description: Spend control for the set's traits unless a trait overrides it.

hitches.description: Top of the hitches inheritance chain. Sparse; base default 1.

ppDelta.description: Plot Point delta applied when staging or rolling a die from this set (positive gains PP, negative spends PP) unless overridden on the trait.

label.description: Display label for the trait. Name-block traits render this instead of the name.

noun.description: Category singular label for this trait or child trait.

plural.description: Category plural label for this trait or child trait.

pool.description: Staging behaviour: adding the node to the roller stages its whole array of available dice.

spendable.description: Spend control: spend a single die (or unit) at a time, marking it unavailable. Spent state lives beside the rating, never in it.

hitches.description: Faces 1..hitches hitch. Sparse: absent inherits from the nearest ancestor that sets it; base default 1. Only 0 is special — the exemption, which rolls separately.

keepsExtra.description: Extra dice kept toward the total when rolled.

ppDelta.description: Plot Point delta applied when staging or rolling this trait's die (positive gains PP, negative spends PP).

xp.description: XP or numeral counter value for this trait.

counter.description: Alternative counter value for this trait.

traits.description: Any child traits attached this parent trait.

rating.description: The node's rating: { type: Counter | Die | Dice | Pip, value: [], range: [] }. Value is always a list; range is the ladder it may take. Absent means unrated.

type.description: Counter = scalar number in value[0]. Die = single-die size in value[0]. Dice = die list in value. Pip = boolean array of checkboxes/bubbles in value. Optional when a child node inherits its rating type from an enclosing trait or set.

value.description: Always a list: die sizes for Die/Dice, a number for Counter, booleans for Pip.

range.description: The ladder: die scale for Die/Dice, [min, max] for Counter, [count] for Pip. Pip may omit it (a lone bubble's [true, false] pair is derived).

out.description: Out is part of this rating's range (one step past the top). Default off; most ratings lack it.

tags.description: A list of taxonomy tags attached to this entity. Tags may include letters, numbers, hyphens, periods, and forward slashes (for namespacing).

view.description: App presentation and view settings (layout, placement, style, features).

custom.description: An open-ended object where apps and services can add custom data to this entity. It is strongly recommended that developers compartmentalize their app’s custom data under a unique key to avoid conflicts and generally be good neighbors.

nickname.description: An optional nickname or callsign for the character.

description.description: A short summary or subtitle for the character.

game.description: The name of the game or campaign that the character belongs to.

plotPoints.description: The character’s current number of plot points. Defaults to 1 when omitted or null.

notes.description: Any additional notes about the character. Format: plaintext or Markdown.

portrait.description: An image to represent the character.

anyOf.description: A URI compatible with the HTML <image> tag.
An empty string to indicate no image.

sets.description: Layered name-keyed map of the character’s trait sets.

traitSets.description: The character’s trait sets (array render shape).

prefs.description: File-traveling arrangement (name-keyed set/trait order + declined template versions). Present only when the user rearranged; live prefs stay app-local.

sheet.description: Layout resolution: template names the sheet template whose values fill in anything not set locally (live: bare { id }; file export: full embedded template object).

template.description: Sheet template reference (live) or embedded template object (export).
Pinned sheet template reference in layered form.

id.description: A unique identifier for the character.

isTemplate.description: Whether this character represents a reusable template.

dateCreated.description: The date and time when the character was first created.

dateModified.description: The date and time when the character was last changed.

dateTouched.description: The date and time when the character was last loaded, viewed or interacted with.
